articles.title_en: Dreaming of leaving the nest? Immigration status and the living arrangements of DACAmented
articles.title_cn: 梦想离开巢穴？移民身份与DACA受益者的居住安排
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the effects of the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) on the living arrangements and housing behavior of undocumented immigrants in the U.S. Using an event-study approach and difference-in-differences (DID) estimates, we compared immigrants above and below eligibility cutoffs and demonstrated that, after the adoption of the policy in June 2012, DACA-eligible immigrants were less likely to live with their parents or in multigenerational households (−12.5%) and more likely to live independently (＋15.5%). We also revealed that DACA-eligible immigrants were less likely to live in the same house (−2%) and more likely to quit ethnic enclaves (＋8%). Notably, these patterns are not explained by the known effects of DACA on income and employment outcomes. Lower rental costs (−3%) may have facilitated this transition into adulthood and the observed trends in living arrangements. The DACA also led to a decline in marriage rates among DACA-eligible individuals, although we found no evidence of significant effects on cohabitation, divorce, and intermarriage. We also found no evidence of a clear impact on fertility.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了童年入境暂缓遣返（DACA）对美国无证移民居住安排和住房行为的影响。采用事件研究法和双重差分（DID）估计，我们比较了资格截止线上下的移民，并证明在2012年六月政策通过后，符合DACA资格的移民与父母同住或生活在多代同堂家庭的可能性降低（−12.5%），而独立居住的可能性增加（＋15.5%）。我们还发现，符合DACA资格的移民居住在同一房屋的可能性降低（−2%），更有可能离开族裔聚居区（＋8%）。值得注意的是，这些模式并不能用DACA对收入和就业结果的已知影响来解释。较低的租金成本（−3%）可能促进了向成年的过渡以及观察到的居住安排趋势。DACA还导致符合资格个体的结婚率下降，尽管我们没有发现对同居、离婚和通婚有显著影响的证据。我们也没有发现对生育有明确影响的证据。

articles.title_en: Monetary and social incentives in multi-tasking: The ranking substitution effect
articles.title_cn: 多任务中的货币与社会激励：排名替代效应
articles.abstract_en: Rankings are intended as incentive tools on labor markets. Yet, when agents perform multiple tasks, rankings might have unintended side-effects, especially if not all tasks can be ranked with respect to performance. We analyze the dynamics of multi-tasking and present an experiment with 286 finance professionals in which we identify hidden ranking costs when performance in one task is ranked while in another prosocial task it is not. We find that subjects lagging behind (leading) in the ranked task devote less (more) effort to the prosocial task. We discuss implications for optimal incentive schemes in organizations with multi-tasking.
articles.abstract_cn: 排名旨在作为劳动力市场上的激励工具。然而，当代理人执行多项任务时，排名可能会产生意想不到的副作用，特别是当并非所有任务都能根据绩效进行排名时。我们分析了多任务的动态，并展示了一项涉及286名金融专业人士的实验，在该实验中，我们识别出当一项任务的绩效被排名而另一项亲社会任务未被排名时，存在隐藏的排名成本。我们发现，在排名任务中落后（领先）的受试者对亲社会任务投入的努力较少（较多）。我们讨论了在具有多任务的组织中优化激励方案的含义。

articles.title_en: Soccer labour market equilibrium and efficient training of players
articles.title_cn: 足球劳动力市场均衡和球员有效培训
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a two-period model of the soccer labour market. The first period is devoted to the selection of players and training, while the second period corresponds to the beginning of the players’ professional career. Between the two periods, players can be hit by idiosyncratic shocks, thus generating mismatches between players and clubs. Some players are transferred in exchange for the payment of a transfer fee by the poaching club to the training club, while others may renegotiate their wages. Our model emphasises the key allocation role played by transfer fees: a training club may benefit from training, even if the player moves to another club at the end of the training period. Using the simulated method of moments, we estimate the impact of transfer fees on training, capitalising on an original data set on the Big-5 European soccer leagues. We show that the presence of transfer fees allows the selection and training of players to get closer to the efficient allocation. Counterfactual experiments then highlight that a significant share of players would not have been trained in the absence of transfer fees.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了足球劳动力市场的两阶段模型。第一个阶段致力于球员的选拔和训练，第二个阶段对应球员职业生涯的开始。在这两个时期之间，球员可能会受到特殊的冲击，从而产生球员和俱乐部之间的不匹配。有些球员是通过挖角俱乐部向训练俱乐部支付转会费来换取的，而另一些球员则可能会重新协商工资。我们的模型强调了转会费所发挥的关键分配作用：即使球员在训练期结束时转会到另一家具乐部，训练俱乐部也可能会从训练中受益。使用矩模拟方法，我们利用欧洲大5足球联赛的原始数据集来估计转会费对训练的影响。我们证明，转会费的存在可以让球员的选拔和培养更加接近高效分配。反事实实验强调，如果没有转会费，很大一部分球员就不会接受训练。

articles.title_en: When reality bites: Local deaths and vaccine take-up
articles.title_cn: 当现实来袭：本地死亡与疫苗接种率
articles.abstract_en: In this study, we investigate whether COVID-19 deaths that occurred before vaccination rollouts impact subsequent vaccination take-up. We use data on local vaccination rates and COVID-19-related deaths from England measured at high geographic granularity. We find that vaccination take-up as of November 2021 is positively associated with pre-vaccine COVID-19-related deaths, controlling for demographic, economic, and health-related characteristics of the localities, while including geographic fixed effects. In addition, the share of ethnic minorities in a locality is negatively associated with vaccination rates, and localities with a larger share of ethnic minorities increase their vaccination rates if they are exposed to more COVID-related-deaths. Further evidence on vaccination intention at the individual level from a representative sample corroborates these patterns. Overall, our evidence suggests that social proximity to victims of the disease triggers a desire to take protective measures against it.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们考察了在疫苗接种推广之前发生的COVID-19死亡是否影响后续的疫苗接种率。我们使用了英格兰高地理粒度测量的本地疫苗接种率和COVID-19相关死亡数据。我们发现，截至2021年十一月的疫苗接种率与疫苗前COVID-19相关死亡呈正相关，同时控制了地区的人口、经济和健康相关特征，并包括地理固定效应。此外，一个地区的少数族裔比例与疫苗接种率呈负相关，而少数族裔比例较大的地区如果暴露于更多COVID相关死亡，其疫苗接种率会提高。来自代表性样本的个体层面疫苗接种意愿的进一步证据证实了这些模式。总体而言，我们的证据表明，与疾病受害者的社会接近会触发采取保护措施的意愿。

articles.title_en: Electoral earthquake: Local shocks and authoritarian voting
articles.title_cn: 选举地震：地方冲击与威权投票
articles.abstract_en: A growing literature has highlighted the role of economic grievances, global transformations, cultural cleavages and long-term trends of isolation and decline in engendering political discontent. However, this literature is silent on the potential role of unanticipated local shocks in fuelling support for authoritarian parties. We fill this gap by using comprehensive data at a fine spatial scale and a comparative natural experiment approach. Our study documents that the occurrence of two destructive earthquakes in Italy resulted in sharply diverging electoral outcomes: while the 2012 Emilia quake did not alter voting behaviour, the 2009 L'Aquila earthquake paved the way for an impressive and persistent authoritarian backlash in the most affected areas. Such heterogeneous patterns originate from a stark contrast in post-disaster reconstruction processes and shifts in institutional trust. These findings suggest that valence issues generated from local shocks can turn “places that don't recover” into authoritarian hotbeds.
articles.abstract_cn: 越来越多的文献强调了经济不满、全球转型、文化分裂以及长期孤立和衰退趋势在引发政治不满中的作用。然而，这些文献并未涉及未预料到的地方冲击在助长对威权政党支持方面的潜在作用。我们通过使用精细空间尺度的综合数据和比较自然实验方法填补了这一空白。我们的研究记录了意大利两次破坏性地震的发生导致了截然不同的选举结果：2012年艾米利亚地震没有改变投票行为，而2009年拉奎拉地震在受影响最严重的地区为令人印象深刻且持续的威权反弹铺平了道路。这种异质性模式源于灾后重建过程和制度信任变化的鲜明对比。这些发现表明，由地方冲击产生的价值问题可以将“未恢复的地方”转变为威权主义的温床。

articles.title_en: Civic engagement, the leverage effect and the accountable state
articles.title_cn: 公民参与、杠杆效应与负责任的政府
articles.abstract_en: A classic solution to the problem of public goods (PG) is their provision through a strong state with the power to collect taxes and to mete out penalties for non-compliance. The need for voluntary collective action remains, however, because binding the state to citizen's interests requires the latter's civic engagement. As a public good in its own right, economic theory expects civic engagement to be underprovided. We conduct the first laboratory experiment in which participants can create a socially efficient central sanctioning scheme (representing the accountable state) through a prior stage of voluntary costly actions that are theoretically ruled out for strictly self-interested agents—a social dilemma. Our experimental subjects sustain civic engagement when its cost is modest, suggesting sustainable cooperation in linked social dilemmas perhaps due to a cost-benefit calculus we call “leverage.”
articles.abstract_cn: 公共品问题的一个经典解决方案是通过一个强有力的国家来提供公共品，该国家有权征税并对不遵守规定者施加惩罚。然而，自愿集体行动的需求仍然存在，因为将国家与公民利益绑定需要后者的公民参与。作为一种公共品本身，经济理论预期公民参与将供给不足。我们进行了首个实验室实验，参与者可以通过先前阶段的自愿成本行动来创建一个社会有效的中央制裁机制（代表负责任的政府），而这些行动在理论上对于严格自利的个体是被排除的——这是一个社会困境。我们的实验对象在成本适中时维持了公民参与，这表明在关联的社会困境中可能存在可持续的合作，或许是由于我们称之为“杠杆”的成本效益计算。

articles.title_en: The informational effect of monetary policy and the case for policy commitment
articles.title_cn: 货币政策的信息效应与政策承诺的必要性
articles.abstract_en: I study how the informational effect of monetary policy changes the optimal conduct of monetary policy. In my model, the private sector extracts information about unobserved fundamental shocks from the central bank’s interest rate decisions. The central bank optimally changes the informational effect of the interest rate by committing to a state-contingent policy rule, in which case the Phillips curve becomes endogenous. In a dynamic model, the optimal policy rule overshoots the natural-rate shock and gradually responds to the cost-push shock, which makes the interest rate change expected output growth but not expected inflation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了货币政策的信息效应如何改变货币政策的最优实施。在我的模型中，私人部门从中央银行的利率决策中提取关于未观测到的基本面冲击的信息。中央银行通过承诺遵循一个状态依存的政策规则来最优地改变利率的信息效应，在这种情况下，菲利普斯曲线变为内生的。在一个动态模型中，最优政策规则对自然率冲击过度反应，并对成本推动冲击逐步作出反应，这使得利率变化预期产出增长而非预期通胀。

articles.title_en: On the design of a European Unemployment Insurance System
articles.title_cn: 论欧洲失业保险制度的设计
articles.abstract_en: We study the welfare effects of both existing and counter-factual European unemployment insurance (UI) policies using a rich multi-country dynamic general equilibrium model with labour market frictions. The model successfully replicates several salient features of European labour markets, in particular the cross-country differences in the flows between employment, unemployment and inactivity, as a result of labour market and UI policy differences across euro area countries. We find that mechanisms like the recently introduced instrument for temporary support to mitigate unemployment risks in an emergency (SURE), which allows national governments to borrow at low interest rates to cover expenditures on unemployment risk, yield sizeable welfare gains. Furthermore, we find that, in spite of the calibrated heterogeneity across euro area countries, there is a common direction in which they can improve their UI policies; in particular, a harmonized benefit system that features a one-time payment of around three quarters of income upon separation is welfare improving in all euro area countries relative to the status quo.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一个包含劳动力市场摩擦的丰富多国动态一般均衡模型，研究现有和反事实的欧洲失业保险（UI）政策的福利效应。该模型成功复制了欧洲劳动力市场的几个显著特征，特别是欧元区国家之间因劳动市场和失业保险政策差异而导致的就业、失业和非经济活动之间流动的跨国差异。我们发现，诸如最近推出的用于缓解紧急情况下失业风险的临时支持工具（SURE）等机制，允许国家政府以低利率借款以覆盖失业风险支出，能产生可观的福利收益。此外，我们发现，尽管欧元区国家之间存在校准的异质性，但它们改善失业保险政策的方向是共同的；特别是，一个统一的福利制度，在离职时一次性支付约收入四分之三的金额，相对于现状在所有欧元区国家中都能改善福利。

articles.title_en: Worker selectivity and fiscal externalities from unemployment insurance
articles.title_cn: 工人选择性与失业保险的财政外部性
articles.abstract_en: A robust prediction of job search models is that unemployment insurance (UI) makes workers more selective about which jobs they accept, thereby raising average accepted wages and thus generating a positive fiscal externality. We provide a sufficient-statistics formula for evaluating the size of this selectivity effect and argue theoretically that it is likely to be small. In a standard sequential search model, the effect of UI on wages is linked to its effect on the job-finding hazard; the slope of the relationship between these elasticities depends on a small number of estimable statistics, key among them observed worker flows. Plausible calibrations of the model imply that the magnitude of the wage elasticity is small relative to the job-finding elasticity. Although ignoring the wage effect of UI would over-estimate its fiscal cost and under-estimate its welfare benefit, the model-implied formula predicts the magnitude of this bias to be small.
articles.abstract_cn: 工作搜寻模型的一个稳健预测是，失业保险（UI）使工人在接受哪些工作方面更具选择性，从而提高平均接受工资，并由此产生正的财政外部性。我们提供了一个充分统计量公式来评估这种选择性效应的大小，并从理论上论证其可能很小。在标准序贯搜寻模型中，UI对工资的影响与其对工作找到率的影响相关联；这些弹性之间关系的斜率取决于少数可估计的统计量，其中关键的是观察到的工人流动。合理的模型校准表明，工资弹性的幅度相对于工作找到弹性较小。尽管忽略UI的工资效应会高估其财政成本并低估其福利收益，但模型隐含的公式预测这种偏差的幅度很小。

articles.title_en: How do wealth–income ratios react to slowing growth in the long run? On Piketty’s second fundamental law of capitalism
articles.title_cn: 财富-收入比率在长期内如何应对增长放缓？——论皮凯蒂的资本主义第二基本定律
articles.abstract_en: Thomas Piketty and some of his coauthors have suggested an economic law named the Second Fundamental Law of Capitalism by Piketty, implying that a long-lasting and considerable growth slowdown will cause substantial increases in wealth–income ratios in the long run. Critics have pointed out that the reaction of wealth–income ratios depends on the reaction of saving/investment rates and, in particular, that sufficiently large decreases in these rates in response to a growth slowdown will revert the direction of Piketty’s law. We conduct a theoretical investigation in a framework that endogenizes the reaction of saving rates in a standard way and find support for a version of Piketty’s Second Law based on an exogenous gross saving rate, but not for Piketty’s original version assuming an exogenous net saving rate. Consequently, the reaction of wealth–income ratios to a substantial growth slowdown will be smaller than suggested by Piketty’s version of the law, but in the same direction and still substantial.
articles.abstract_cn: 托马斯·皮凯蒂及其一些合著者提出了一个名为皮凯蒂资本主义第二基本定律的经济学定律，暗示长期且显著的增长放缓将导致长期内财富-收入比率大幅上升。批评者指出，财富-收入比率的反应取决于储蓄/投资率的反应，特别是，如果这些比率因增长放缓而大幅下降，将逆转皮凯蒂定律的方向。我们在一个以标准方式内生储蓄率反应的框架中进行了理论调查，发现支持基于外生总储蓄率的皮凯蒂第二定律版本，但不支持皮凯蒂原始版本中假设外生净储蓄率的版本。因此，财富-收入比率对显著增长放缓的反应将小于皮凯蒂定律版本所暗示的，但方向相同且仍然显著。

articles.title_en: The politicized pandemic: Ideological polarization and the behavioral response to COVID-19
articles.title_cn: 政治化的疫情：意识形态极化与对COVID-19的行为反应
articles.abstract_en: In a representative sample of the U.S. population during the first summer of the COVID-19 pandemic, we investigate how prosociality and ideology interact in their relationship with health-protecting behavior and trust in the government to handle the crisis. We find that an experimental measure of prosociality based on standard economic games positively relates to protective behavior. Conservatives are less compliant with COVID-19-related behavioral restrictions than liberals and evaluate the government's handling of the crisis significantly more positively. We show that prosociality does not mediate the impact of political ideology. This finding means that conservatives are less compliant with protective health guidelines - independent of differences in prosociality between both ideological camps. Behavioral differences between liberals and conservatives are roughly only one-fourth of the size of their differences in judging the government's crisis management. This result suggests that Americans were more polarized in their political views than in their acceptance of public health advice.
articles.abstract_cn: 在COVID-19大流行第一个夏季的美国代表性样本中，我们研究了亲社会性与意识形态如何在其与健康保护行为和信任政府处理危机的关系中相互作用。我们发现，基于标准经济博弈的实验性亲社会性测量与保护行为正相关。保守派比自由派更不遵守与COVID-19相关的行为限制，并且对政府处理危机的评价显著更为积极。我们表明，亲社会性并不中介政治意识形态的影响。这一发现意味着保守派更不遵守保护性健康指南——独立于两个意识形态阵营之间亲社会性的差异。自由派与保守派之间的行为差异大约仅为他们评判政府危机管理差异的四分之一。这一结果表明，美国人在政治观点上的极化程度高于他们在接受公共卫生建议方面的分歧。

articles.title_en: Business dynamism, sectoral reallocation and productivity in a pandemic
articles.title_cn: 疫情中的商业活力、部门重新配置与生产率
articles.abstract_en: Asymmetric effects across sectors are the distinctive features of the Covid-19 shock. An Epidemiological-Industry Dynamic model with heterogeneous firms and endogenous firms dynamics mimics the deep recession suffered by sectors characterized by high exposure, the reallocation of entry and exit opportunities across sectors, and the dynamics of aggregate productivity during the first wave of the pandemic. The cleansing effect induced by the Covid-19 crisis is sector-specific. Monetary policy and sticky wages are central ingredients to capture reallocation effects. Social distancing, by smoothing out cleansing in the social sector, slows down the reallocation process and prolongs the recession, but saves lives.
articles.abstract_cn: 跨部门的非对称效应是Covid-19冲击的显著特征。一个具有异质性企业和内生企业动态的流行病-产业动态模型，模拟了高暴露部门所遭受的深度衰退、跨部门的进入与退出机会的重新配置，以及疫情第一波期间总体生产率的动态。Covid-19危机引发的清洁效应具有部门特异性。货币政策和工资粘性是捕捉重新配置效应的核心要素。社交距离通过平滑社会部门的清洁效应，减缓了重新配置过程并延长了衰退，但挽救了生命。

articles.title_en: Inflation and wage growth since the pandemic
articles.title_cn: 疫情以来的通货膨胀与工资增长
articles.abstract_en: Following the worst of the COVID-19 pandemic, inflation surged to levels last seen in the 1980s. Motivated by vast differences in pandemic support across countries, we investigate the subsequent response of inflation and its feedback to wages. We exploit the differences in pandemic support to identify the effect that these programs had on inflation and the passthrough to wages. Our empirical approach focuses on a novel dynamic difference-in-differences method based on local projections. Our estimates suggest that an increase of 5 percentage points in direct transfers (relative to trend) translates into about a peak 3 percentage points boost to inflation and wage growth. Moreover, higher inflation accentuates the role of inflation expectations on wage-setting dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 在COVID-19疫情最严重时期之后，通货膨胀飙升至1980年代以来未见的高位。鉴于各国在疫情支持方面的巨大差异，我们研究了通货膨胀随后的反应及其对工资的反馈效应。我们利用疫情支持政策的差异来识别这些项目对通货膨胀的影响及其向工资的传导。我们的实证方法基于局部投影，采用一种新颖的动态双重差分法。我们的估计表明，直接转移支付（相对于趋势）增加5个百分点，大约会转化为通货膨胀和工资增长峰值提高3个百分点。此外，更高的通货膨胀加剧了通胀预期在工资设定动态中的作用。

articles.title_en: Wall Street QE vs. Main Street Lending
articles.title_cn: 华尔街量化宽松与主街贷款
articles.abstract_en: Monetary and fiscal authorities reacted swiftly to the COVID-19 pandemic by purchasing assets (or “Wall Street QE”) and lending directly to non-financial firms (or “Main Street Lending”). Our paper develops a new framework to compare and contrast these different policies. For the Great Recession, characterized by impaired balance sheets of financial intermediaries, Main Street Lending and Wall Street QE are perfect substitutes and both stimulate aggregate demand. In contrast, for the COVID-19 recession, where non-financial firms faced significant cash flow shortages, Wall Street QE is almost completely ineffective, whereas Main Street Lending can be highly stimulative.
articles.abstract_cn: 货币和财政当局通过购买资产（即“华尔街量化宽松”）和直接向非金融企业贷款（即“主街贷款”）迅速应对COVID-19疫情。我们的论文开发了一个新框架来比较和对比这些不同的政策。对于以大萧条为特征的金融中介机构资产负债表受损的情况，主街贷款和华尔街量化宽松是完全替代品，两者都能刺激总需求。相比之下，对于非金融企业面临显著现金流短缺的COVID-19衰退，华尔街量化宽松几乎完全无效，而主街贷款则可能具有高度刺激性。

articles.title_en: Unconventional monetary policy and local fiscal policy
articles.title_cn: 非常规货币政策与地方财政政策
articles.abstract_en: Following the onset of the pandemic, the Federal Reserve employed an unconventional monetary policy that directly intervened in municipal bond markets. We characterize the fiscal and macroeconomic implications of such central bank actions in a New Keynesian model of a monetary union. We assume that state and local governments are subject to a loan-in-advance constraint, reflecting that with lumpy cash flows, they often finance a fraction of expenditures by issuing short-term bonds. The municipal debt is held by financial intermediaries, who also supply credit to the private sector. Direct central bank purchases can transmit to the economy through two main channels: (1) by alleviating cash flow problems of the regional governments and (2) by accelerating lending to the private sector if credit constraints ease more broadly. By quantifying the relative importance of these channels, we highlight that the central bank’s actions lead to sizable increases in private investment but have more muted effects on state and local government expenditures. In addition, we also show the transmission of direct federal government aid through intergovernmental transfers is markedly different from unconventional policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 疫情爆发后，美联储采取了直接干预市政债券市场的非常规货币政策。我们在一个货币联盟的新凯恩斯模型中刻画了此类央行行动的财政和宏观经济影响。我们假设州和地方政府面临贷款预付约束，这反映了由于现金流不规律，它们通常通过发行短期债券来为部分支出融资。市政债务由金融中介持有，这些中介同时也向私人部门提供信贷。央行的直接购买可以通过两个主要渠道传导至经济：（1）缓解地方政府的现金流问题；（2）如果信贷约束更广泛地放松，则加速对私人部门的贷款。通过量化这些渠道的相对重要性，我们强调央行的行动导致私人投资显著增加，但对州和地方政府支出的影响则较为温和。此外，我们还表明，通过政府间转移支付的联邦政府直接援助的传导与非常规政策显著不同。

articles.title_en: The Great Lockdown: Pandemic response policies and bank lending conditions
articles.title_cn: 大封锁：疫情应对政策与银行贷款条件
articles.abstract_en: This study analyses the effects of monetary and prudential policies taken in response to the outbreak of the coronavirus pandemic to support bank lending conditions. More precisely, we focus on the effects of targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTROs) and their interaction with supervisory measures taken in the euro area. For identification, we use proprietary data on participation in central bank liquidity operations, high-frequency reactions to monetary policy announcements, and confidential supervisory information on bank capital requirements. We show that, in the absence of the funding cost relief associated with the pandemic response measures, banks’ ability to supply credit would have been severely affected. The results are robust to controlling for other concomitant policy measures such as government guarantees or quantitative easing. Our findings also indicate that the coordinated intervention by monetary and prudential authorities amplified the effects of the individual measures in supporting liquidity conditions and helping to sustain the flow of credit to the private sector. Finally, we find that, while monetary and prudential policies did not promote “zombie” lending and “zombie” firms, in absence of these measures the pandemic would have led to a significantly larger decline in firms’ employment.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了为应对新冠疫情爆发而采取的货币和审慎政策对支持银行贷款条件的影响。更确切地说，我们关注定向长期再融资操作（TLTROs）及其与欧元区采取的监管措施相互作用的效果。为了识别，我们使用了关于参与中央银行流动性操作的专有数据、对货币政策公告的高频反应以及关于银行资本要求的保密监管信息。我们表明，如果没有与疫情应对措施相关的融资成本减免，银行提供信贷的能力将受到严重影响。结果在控制其他伴随政策措施（如政府担保或量化宽松）后依然稳健。我们的发现还表明，货币和审慎当局的协调干预放大了各项措施在支持流动性条件和帮助维持向私营部门信贷流动方面的效果。最后，我们发现，虽然货币和审慎政策并未促进“僵尸”贷款和“僵尸”企业，但如果没有这些措施，疫情将导致企业就业显著更大的下降。

articles.title_en: Commodity terms of trade volatility and industry growth
articles.title_cn: 大宗商品贸易条件波动与行业增长
articles.abstract_en: The rising volatility of commodity terms of trade (CTOT) is associated with a high cost of capital and a low credit supply for producers in commodity-dependent countries. In this paper, we examine how volatile CTOT influences various industries’ growth performance based on sector-level panel data for countries specializing in commodity exports. We find robust evidence that CTOT volatility causes a more significant growth loss in manufacturing sectors facing tighter credit constraints. The adverse growth effects operate through lower total factor productivity in industries heavily reliant on external finance for long-term investments and through lower capital accumulation in industries with high liquidity needs for short-term working capital. Our findings offer a complementary explanation for the “resource curse” through the credit constraint channel.
articles.abstract_cn: 大宗商品贸易条件（CTOT）波动性的上升与依赖大宗商品的国家中生产者面临的高资本成本和低信贷供给相关。在本文中，我们基于专门出口大宗商品的国家的部门层面面板数据，考察了CTOT波动如何影响各行业的增长表现。我们发现了稳健的证据，表明CTOT波动对面临更严格信贷约束的制造业部门造成的增长损失更为显著。不利的增长效应通过以下途径发挥作用：在长期投资中严重依赖外部融资的行业，其全要素生产率下降；在短期营运资金流动性需求高的行业，资本积累减少。我们的发现通过信贷约束渠道为“资源诅咒”提供了补充解释。

articles.title_en: Banning volume discounts to curb excessive consumption: A cautionary tale
articles.title_cn: 禁止数量折扣以遏制过度消费：一个警示故事
articles.abstract_en: Volume discounts encourage consumers to buy more. Banning such discounts should then lead to consumers buying less. This is the thinking behind banning multiple-unit discounts, including multibuy price promotions, to curb excessive harmful consumption of alcohol and high-fat, -sugar, and -salt (HFSS) foods. However, our analysis questions the validity of this thinking, which ignores the possible restraining effect of volume discounts. We find that such a ban for retailing alcohol in Scotland increased rather than reduced sales. Retailers switched to using more straight (single-unit) discounts, which encouraged high-consumption households to increase their shopping frequency and buy more.
articles.abstract_cn: 数量折扣鼓励消费者购买更多。禁止此类折扣应导致消费者减少购买。这是禁止多单位折扣（包括多买优惠促销）以遏制酒精和高脂肪、高糖、高盐（HFSS）食品过度有害消费背后的逻辑。然而，我们的分析质疑了这一逻辑的有效性，因为它忽略了数量折扣可能具有的抑制作用。我们发现，苏格兰对酒精零售实施此类禁令反而增加了而非减少了销售量。零售商转而使用更多直接（单单位）折扣，这鼓励了高消费家庭增加购物频率并购买更多。

articles.title_en: Firms’ financing dynamics around lumpy capacity adjustments
articles.title_cn: 企业围绕块状产能调整的融资动态
articles.abstract_en: We study how firms adjust their financial positions around the times when they undertake lumpy adjustments in capital or employment. Using U.S. firm level data, we document systematic patterns of cash and debt financing around lumpy adjustment, remarkably similar across capital and employment. Firm-specific fundamentals reflected in Tobin’s Q, profitability and productivity are leading indicators of lumpy adjustment. Cash and debt capacity are actively manipulated, and contribute significantly quantitatively, to increase financial resources in anticipation of the expansion of firm capacity. Lumpy contractions in productive capacity follow years where firms reduce cash balances and hold above average levels of debt. During and after contractions, firms rebuild cash and reduce debt growth significantly in a concerted effort to restore financial resources by adjusting their productive operations.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了企业在进行资本或就业的块状调整时如何调整其财务状况。利用美国企业层面数据，我们记录了围绕块状调整的现金和债务融资的系统性模式，这些模式在资本和就业方面惊人地相似。反映在托宾Q、盈利能力和生产率中的企业特定基本面因素是块状调整的领先指标。现金和债务能力被积极操纵，并在数量上显著地有助于增加财务资源，以预期企业产能的扩张。产能的块状收缩发生在企业减少现金余额并持有高于平均水平的债务之后的几年。在收缩期间和之后，企业重建现金并显著降低债务增长，通过调整其生产运营来协同努力恢复财务资源。

articles.title_en: Do markets overcome repugnance? Muslim trade response to anti-Muhammad cartoons
articles.title_cn: 市场能否克服厌恶？穆斯林对反穆罕默德漫画的贸易反应
articles.abstract_en: What is the effect of religious beliefs on economic choices? And in light of this effect, what is the cost of free speech? After Danish newspapers published anti-Muhammad cartoons, the religious status of trade with Denmark changed exogenously in Muslim countries. Exports from Denmark to Muslim countries decreased by 31%, while close substitute countries like Finland gained export share. Final goods were more affected than intermediate goods, as were more religious Muslim countries. Denmark did not shift exports to other countries, but trade quantity rebounded in 20 months. Notably, Muslim exports to Denmark were unaffected, which is consistent with money overcoming repugnance.
articles.abstract_cn: 宗教信仰对经济选择有何影响？鉴于这种影响，言论自由的代价是什么？在丹麦报纸刊登反穆罕默德漫画后，穆斯林国家与丹麦贸易的宗教地位发生了外生变化。丹麦对穆斯林国家的出口下降了31%，而像芬兰这样的近似替代国家则获得了出口份额。最终产品比中间产品受影响更大，宗教性更强的穆斯林国家也是如此。丹麦并未将出口转向其他国家，但贸易量在20个月后回升。值得注意的是，穆斯林对丹麦的出口未受影响，这与金钱克服厌恶的观点一致。

articles.title_en: Wealth preference and rational bubbles
articles.title_cn: 财富偏好与理性泡沫
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we show that rational bubbles can exist within a neoclassical economy, provided that households derive utility from holding wealth. Hence, we provide a microfoundation for bubbles that relies on a frictionless economy with an infinitely-lived representative household. While our bubbly equilibria are very similar to those obtained by Tirole (1985) in an overlapping generation economy, the underlying mechanism is fundamentally different. Instead of relying on an exchange across heterogeneous households, the bubble relies on the representative household’s willingness to accumulate wealth without the intention of spending it. Turning to public debt, we carefully review the similarities and the differences between rational bubbles and Ponzi schemes. We establish that the Ricardian equivalence must hold in any of our equilibria. Finally, within a monetary economy, we show that the preference for wealth is fundamentally different from money-in-the-utility-function.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们表明，只要家庭从持有财富中获得效用，理性泡沫就可以存在于新古典经济中。因此，我们为泡沫提供了一个微观基础，该基础依赖于一个无摩擦的经济，其中有一个无限期生存的代表性家庭。虽然我们的泡沫均衡与Tirole（1985）在重叠世代经济中获得的均衡非常相似，但潜在机制根本不同。泡沫不依赖于异质家庭之间的交换，而是依赖于代表性家庭积累财富而不打算花费的意愿。转向公共债务，我们仔细回顾了理性泡沫与庞氏骗局之间的相似之处和不同之处。我们确定，李嘉图等价在我们的任何均衡中都必须成立。最后，在货币经济中，我们表明财富偏好与效用函数中的货币根本不同。

articles.title_en: Optimal monetary policy in an estimated SIR model
articles.title_cn: 估计SIR模型中的最优货币政策
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the design of Ramsey optimal monetary policy in a Health New Keynesian (HeNK) model with Susceptible, Infected and Recovered (SIR) agents. The nonlinear model is estimated with maximum likelihood techniques on Euro Area data. Our objective is to deconstruct the mechanism by which contagion risk affects the conduct of monetary policy. If monetary policy is the only game in town, we find that optimal policy features significant deviations from price stability to mitigate the effect of the pandemic. The best outcome is obtained when the optimal Ramsey policy is combined with a lockdown strategy of medium intensity. In this case, monetary policy can concentrate on its price stabilization objective.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在一个包含易感、感染和康复（SIR）主体的健康新凯恩斯（HeNK）模型中研究了拉姆齐最优货币政策的设计。该非线性模型使用最大似然技术对欧元区数据进行估计。我们的目标是解构传染风险影响货币政策执行的机制。如果货币政策是唯一的政策工具，我们发现最优政策表现出显著偏离价格稳定的特征，以减轻疫情的影响。当最优拉姆齐政策与中等强度的封锁策略相结合时，可获得最佳结果。在这种情况下，货币政策可以专注于其价格稳定目标。

articles.title_en: The global financial cycle and capital flows during the COVID-19 pandemic
articles.title_cn: 全球金融周期与COVID-19疫情期间的资本流动
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the heterogeneous effect of the global financial cycle on exchange rates and cross-border capital flows during the COVID-19 pandemic, using weekly exchange rate and portfolio flow data for a panel of 59 advanced and emerging market economies. We estimate a global financial cycle (GFC) index at the weekly frequency with data through the end of 2021. We then estimate the country-specific sensitivities of exchange rates and capital flows to fluctuations in the GFC. The ability of the GFC to explain fluctuations in exchange rates and capital flows increased dramatically during the pandemic. There is significant cross-country heterogeneity in the response of exchange rates or capital flows to fluctuations in the GFC. During the pandemic, high-frequency indicators like weekly changes in Covid cases and vaccination rates were just as important as standard macroeconomic fundamentals like the current account, reserves, and net foreign assets in explaining this heterogeneity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用59个发达和新兴市场经济体的每周汇率和组合流动数据，估计了COVID-19疫情期间全球金融周期对汇率和跨境资本流动的异质性影响。我们使用截至2021年底的数据，以周度频率估计全球金融周期（GFC）指数。然后，我们估计了各国汇率和资本流动对GFC波动的敏感性。疫情期间，GFC解释汇率和资本流动波动的能力显著增强。汇率或资本流动对GFC波动的响应存在显著的跨国异质性。疫情期间，诸如每周新冠病例变化和疫苗接种率等高频指标，在解释这种异质性方面，与经常账户、储备和净外国资产等标准宏观经济基本面同样重要。

articles.title_en: Sectoral shocks, reallocation, and labor market policies
articles.title_cn: 部门冲击、再配置与劳动力市场政策
articles.abstract_en: Unemployment insurance and wage subsidies are key tools to support labor markets in recessions. We develop a multisector search-and-matching model with on-the-job human capital accumulation to study labor market policy responses to sector-specific shocks. Our calibration accounts for structural differences in labor markets between the United States and the euro area, including a lower job-finding rate in the latter. We use the model to evaluate unemployment insurance and wage subsidy policies in recessions of different duration. After a temporary sector-specific shock, unemployment insurance improves reallocation toward productive sectors at the cost of initially higher unemployment and, thus, human capital destruction. By contrast, wage subsidies reduce unemployment and preserve human capital at the cost of limiting reallocation. In the United States, unemployment insurance is preferred to wage subsidies when it does not distort job creation for too long. In the euro area, wage subsidies are preferred, given the lower job-finding rate and reallocation.
articles.abstract_cn: 失业保险和工资补贴是衰退时期支持劳动力市场的关键工具。我们构建了一个包含在职人力资本积累的多部门搜寻匹配模型，以研究针对特定部门冲击的劳动力市场政策应对。我们的校准考虑了美国和欧元区劳动力市场的结构性差异，包括后者较低的求职率。我们利用该模型评估不同持续时间衰退中的失业保险和工资补贴政策。在暂时的部门特定冲击之后，失业保险改善了向生产性部门的再配置，但代价是初期失业率上升，从而造成人力资本破坏。相比之下，工资补贴降低了失业率并保留了人力资本，但代价是限制了再配置。在美国，当失业保险不会过久地扭曲就业创造时，它优于工资补贴。在欧元区，鉴于较低的求职率和再配置，工资补贴更受青睐。
